dialogues.jp:
「あいかわらず、ここは敬虔な気分になれる
　……もしくは、幼少の頃の｛きょうしゅう／郷愁｝か」
dialogues.en:
"That place always stirs up weird feelings inside me... it
must be the nostalgia from years ago."
dialogues.text:
"That place always stirs up weird feelings inside me... it
must be the nostalgia from years ago."

dialogues.jp: そんなことを思いながら、神社の境内に立つ俺。
dialogues.en:
I thought to myself, as I thought about the times I spent
there recently.
dialogues.text:
I thought to myself, as I thought about the times I spent
there recently.

dialogues.jp: ここにいるのも訳がある。
dialogues.en: There is a reason why I'm here, though.
dialogues.text: There is a reason why I'm here, though.

dialogues.jp:
授業が終わり、部活に向かう奴や、教室に残っ
て喋ってる奴がいて、学園がある意味一番活気
づいている。
dialogues.en:
After tests, the school becomes filled with noise from the
people with club activities, and loiterers talking about the
exams.
dialogues.text:
After tests, the school becomes filled with noise from the
people with club activities, and loiterers talking about the
exams.

dialogues.jp: 「だからといって、俺が残る義理はない、と」
dialogues.en: "So, there's no reason for me to stay there."
dialogues.text: "So, there's no reason for me to stay there."

dialogues.jp:
立ち上がって伸びをすると、体中に疲れがたまっ
ているのがわかった。
dialogues.en: I stretched, feeling the tiredness run through my body.
dialogues.text: I stretched, feeling the tiredness run through my body.

dialogues.jp: ……おかしい。授業中、ちゃんと寝てたのに。
dialogues.en:
...Which was strange, as I slept quite a bit during the
exams.
dialogues.text:
...Which was strange, as I slept quite a bit during the
exams.

dialogues.jp: 「帰ったら寝るしかないな」
dialogues.en: "I won't be able to sleep if I head home, anyway."
dialogues.text: "I won't be able to sleep if I head home, anyway."

dialogues.jp: そう決めていると。
dialogues.en: And since I decided that,
dialogues.text: And since I decided that,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃーん」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chaan!"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chaan!"

dialogues.jp: さくらが元気よく入って来た。
dialogues.en: Sakura interrupted my train of thought, filled with spirit.
dialogues.text: Sakura interrupted my train of thought, filled with spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やっほーっ♪」
dialogues.en: "Ya-hoo~"
dialogues.text: "Ya-hoo~"

dialogues.jp: 無意味に元気を振りまいてくれる。
dialogues.en: A completely mindless and energetic attitude, as usual.
dialogues.text: A completely mindless and energetic attitude, as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ？　どうしたの？　そんなに見つめら
　れると、ボク照れちゃうよ」
dialogues.en: "Unya? What's up? Your staring is making embarassing me!"
dialogues.text: "Unya? What's up? Your staring is making embarassing me!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな。いっぱい照れていいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Good, get as embarassed as possible."
dialogues.text: "Good, get as embarassed as possible."

dialogues.jp:
こいつを見てると、『人間はいつか死ぬんだ』っ
てことを忘れられるような気がしてくる。
dialogues.en:
Looking at her, the end of humanity as we know it could take
place, and you could probably forget that it's happening.
dialogues.text:
Looking at her, the end of humanity as we know it could take
place, and you could probably forget that it's happening.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はにゃ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "Ha-nyaaan~"
dialogues.text: "Ha-nyaaan~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……照れてるのか、それで」
dialogues.en: "...That's getting embarassed?"
dialogues.text: "...That's getting embarassed?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんっ♪」
dialogues.en: "Yep~"
dialogues.text: "Yep~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁいい。で、何か用か？」
dialogues.en: "...Whatever. What do you want?"
dialogues.text: "...Whatever. What do you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん。一緒に帰ろう！」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home together!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go home together!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「マジか」
dialogues.en: "You're serious?"
dialogues.text: "You're serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「マジもマジ、大マジだよ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm more serious than a really serious person!"
dialogues.text: "I'm more serious than a really serious person!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
（こいつと一緒に帰ると、後々まで一緒に居な
　いといけないからなぁ……）
dialogues.en:
"(If I go home with her, I'm not gonna be alone for the rest
of the day...)"
dialogues.text:
"(If I go home with her, I'm not gonna be alone for the rest
of the day...)"

dialogues.jp: それは色々とあれだ。
dialogues.en: And end up doing lots of crap.
dialogues.text: And end up doing lots of crap.

dialogues.jp: かったるい。
dialogues.en: How troublesome.
dialogues.text: How troublesome.

dialogues.jp: よし、何か適当に用事を作るか。
dialogues.en: TIme to come up with a good excuse.
dialogues.text: TIme to come up with a good excuse.

dialogues.jp: 「悪い。今日は神社に行く用事があるから」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I've got stuff to do at the shrine today."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I've got stuff to do at the shrine today."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「神社？」
dialogues.en: "The shrine?"
dialogues.text: "The shrine?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おう。だから、また今度な」
dialogues.en: "Yup. So, maybe next time."
dialogues.text: "Yup. So, maybe next time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それって、噂の巫女さんのところでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that where that famous Miko is?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that where that famous Miko is?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだけど」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, yeah, but..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, yeah, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクも行く〜」
dialogues.en: "Then I'd go too~"
dialogues.text: "Then I'd go too~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だってボク、巫女さんってすごく興味がある
　んだもん。｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝だったら、ボクの恋敵な訳だ
　し。なおさらだよ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm really interested in Miko, after all! And she's my
rival in love too, so even more reason to go!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm really interested in Miko, after all! And she's my
rival in love too, so even more reason to go!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ね、お兄ちゃん、連れてって」
dialogues.en: "So you'll acommpany there, right, onii-chan?"
dialogues.text: "So you'll acommpany there, right, onii-chan?"

dialogues.jp: ……しまった。
dialogues.en: ...Well crap.
dialogues.text: ...Well crap.

dialogues.jp: 火に油を注いでしまった。
dialogues.en: Out of the frying pan, and into the fire.
dialogues.text: Out of the frying pan, and into the fire.

dialogues.jp: 教室を見渡すと、環はもう帰ったようだった。
dialogues.en:
Quickly checking around the classroom, it appeared that
Tamaki had already went home.
dialogues.text:
Quickly checking around the classroom, it appeared that
Tamaki had already went home.

dialogues.jp:
（さくらは、おとなしく引き下がるようなヤツ
　じゃないしな）
dialogues.en: "(Sakura isn't one who'd get discouraged easily either...)"
dialogues.text: "(Sakura isn't one who'd get discouraged easily either...)"

dialogues.jp: 俺が考え込んでいると。
dialogues.en: I quickly pondered my options.
dialogues.text: I quickly pondered my options.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん、何してるの？　早く来ないと置
　いてっちゃうよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"What will you be doing, onii-chan? If you don't hurry up
and decide, the line will only get longer~"
dialogues.text:
"What will you be doing, onii-chan? If you don't hurry up
and decide, the line will only get longer~"

dialogues.jp:
さくらが教室の入口で思いっきり手を振ってい
た。
dialogues.en: She waved to me from the door of the classroom.
dialogues.text: She waved to me from the door of the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 俺が置いてかれるのか？
dialogues.en: The line will only get longer?
dialogues.text: The line will only get longer?

dialogues.jp: 「……ったく、かったりぃなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...Tsk, so troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...Tsk, so troublesome."

dialogues.jp:
口元に苦笑を浮かべながら、さくらの後を追っ
た。
dialogues.en:
With a tiny smile playing on my lips, I followed after
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
With a tiny smile playing on my lips, I followed after
Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「すごい石段の数だね〜」
dialogues.en: "So many steps!~"
dialogues.text: "So many steps!~"

dialogues.jp:
そう言いながらも、さくらは息が乱れる様子が
無い。
dialogues.en: She whirled around as she skipped up each step.
dialogues.text: She whirled around as she skipped up each step.

dialogues.jp: 「やはり、子供は元気だな」
dialogues.en: "Just like a kid..."
dialogues.text: "Just like a kid..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何か言った？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? Did you say something?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? Did you say something?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に……」
dialogues.en: "Nah, nothing..."
dialogues.text: "Nah, nothing..."

dialogues.jp:
段を上りきり、鳥居に到着すると、環が掃除を
していた。
dialogues.en:
We made steady progress up the steps, eventually reaching
the top, where Tamaki was sweeping.
dialogues.text:
We made steady progress up the steps, eventually reaching
the top, where Tamaki was sweeping.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こんちは〜」
dialogues.en: "'Afternoon~"
dialogues.text: "'Afternoon~"

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、いつも通りの元気のよさで、環に挨
拶をする。
dialogues.en: Sakura greeted Tamaki with her usual pep.
dialogues.text: Sakura greeted Tamaki with her usual pep.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "My, good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "My, good afternoon."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日はお二人でいらしてくれたんですね」
dialogues.en: "I see the two of you have come to visit today."
dialogues.text: "I see the two of you have come to visit today."

dialogues.jp: と、笑顔で迎えてくれる。
dialogues.en: She met us with a smile.
dialogues.text: She met us with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「こいつが連れてってくれって言うからさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm just accompanying this thing here."
dialogues.text: "I'm just accompanying this thing here."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　お兄ちゃんが神社に用事があったん
　じゃ……フゴフゴ……」
dialogues.en:
"Huh? Didn't you say that you had something to do
at.....mmphmpph..."
dialogues.text:
"Huh? Didn't you say that you had something to do
at.....mmphmpph..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらが言い終わらないうちに、その口を手で
押さえる。
dialogues.en: Not shutting up herself, I shut Sakura's mouth for her.
dialogues.text: Not shutting up herself, I shut Sakura's mouth for her.

dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは。何言ってるかなぁ、こいつは」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha ha, I wonder what she's saying!"
dialogues.text: "Ha ha ha, I wonder what she's saying!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「フゴフゴ〜ッ！」
dialogues.en: "Mmphmmmph~~!"
dialogues.text: "Mmphmmmph~~!"

dialogues.jp:
怒っているのかも知れないが、まったく迫力は
なかった。
dialogues.en: She sounded a bit angry, but put up no resistance anyway.
dialogues.text: She sounded a bit angry, but put up no resistance anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Hehe..."
dialogues.text: "Hehe..."

dialogues.jp:
俺とさくらとのやりとりに環はいかにも、微笑
ましいといった笑みを浮かべていた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki kept on looking at our camaderie, smiling and
giggling throughout.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki kept on looking at our camaderie, smiling and
giggling throughout.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかったら、お茶でもどうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you like some tea?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like some tea?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「悪いな。いただくよ」
dialogues.en: "If you would, please."
dialogues.text: "If you would, please."

dialogues.jp: 環に案内されて、中へ通される。
dialogues.en:
With Tamaki's guidance, we made our way deeper into the
shrine.
dialogues.text:
With Tamaki's guidance, we made our way deeper into the
shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　普通の家みたいだね」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh? It looks just like a normal home."
dialogues.text: "Ehhh? It looks just like a normal home."

dialogues.jp: 俺の手を逃れたさくらが呟いた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura had escaped from my grip, and was wandering around
the place.
dialogues.text:
Sakura had escaped from my grip, and was wandering around
the place.

dialogues.jp: 「普通って？」
dialogues.en: "Normal?"
dialogues.text: "Normal?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もっと、お札とか動物の飾り物とか、色々あ
　るのかと思ったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I thought there'd be more wallscrolls, or animal ornaments,
and stuff like that."
dialogues.text:
"I thought there'd be more wallscrolls, or animal ornaments,
and stuff like that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？　なんだよそれ？」
dialogues.en: "...The hell?"
dialogues.text: "...The hell?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だって、巫女さんってさ、妖怪退治とか、魔
　界に行く方法を知ってたり……」
dialogues.en:
"Aren't Miko exorcers of the undead, travelers to the
underworld, using techniques of the Gods to assassinate
evil?"
dialogues.text:
"Aren't Miko exorcers of the undead, travelers to the
underworld, using techniques of the Gods to assassinate
evil?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……お前は、マンガの見過ぎだ」
dialogues.en: "...You've been reading too much manga."
dialogues.text: "...You've been reading too much manga."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え〜っ！　違うの〜？」
dialogues.en: "Ehhhh!? Am I wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Ehhhh!? Am I wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「マンガの巫女さんや、陰陽師とは違うんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Those Miko and diviners in manga are hardly the same in
real life."
dialogues.text:
"Those Miko and diviners in manga are hardly the same in
real life."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……くすっ」
dialogues.en: "...*giggle*"
dialogues.text: "...*giggle*"

dialogues.jp: 間違ったさくらの巫女観に環が苦笑する。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki let out a tiny chuckle at Sakura's interpretation of
her kind.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki let out a tiny chuckle at Sakura's interpretation of
her kind.

dialogues.jp:
「そういや、巫女さんはなんとなくわかるんだ
　けど、陰陽師って、結局何なの？」
dialogues.en:
"Speaking of whch, I more or less know what Miko do, but
what about diviners? What do they do, exactly?"
dialogues.text:
"Speaking of whch, I more or less know what Miko do, but
what about diviners? What do they do, exactly?"

dialogues.jp: 自分で言っておいて、ふと気になってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Having reprimanded Sakura for her ignorance, I then became
acutely aware of my own.
dialogues.text:
Having reprimanded Sakura for her ignorance, I then became
acutely aware of my own.

dialogues.jp:
マンガや映画などでは、どうも妖怪退治の専門
家みたいな描かれ方ばかりしている。
dialogues.en:
Manga and movies tend to potray them as specialists in
exorcism and ghost extermination.
dialogues.text:
Manga and movies tend to potray them as specialists in
exorcism and ghost extermination.

dialogues.jp:
かといって、まさか、本当に妖怪がいたとは思
えない。
dialogues.en: They couldn't be the same thing in real life, surely...
dialogues.text: They couldn't be the same thing in real life, surely...

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺の質問に答えてくれるのか、こほんと
軽く咳払いをした。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki cleared her throat, and proceeded to answer my
question.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki cleared her throat, and proceeded to answer my
question.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「陰陽五行説って言うんですけど、世の中のも
　のは全て、陰と陽で成り立っていて……」
dialogues.en:
"Diviners work with the 5 elements of the world, based on
the forces of yin and yang..."
dialogues.text:
"Diviners work with the 5 elements of the world, based on
the forces of yin and yang..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「木、火、土、金、水の五つの要素の働きを五
　行とする考え方なんです」
dialogues.en:
"From the forces, the 5 elements of wood, fire, earth, gold
and water were conjured."
dialogues.text:
"From the forces, the 5 elements of wood, fire, earth, gold
and water were conjured."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふむふむ」

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「お守りやしめ縄も、陰陽道から来てますし、
　節分、ひな祭、七夕もそこから来てるんです
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"Spiritual charms, onmyoudou, bean-throwing night and the
Hina and Weaver festivals are other examples of customs from
diviners."
dialogues.text:
"Spiritual charms, onmyoudou, bean-throwing night and the
Hina and Weaver festivals are other examples of customs from
diviners."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「へえ〜」
dialogues.en: "He-eeh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eeh..."

dialogues.jp: 思わず、口から『へえ』がたくさん漏れそうだ。
dialogues.en: I unconsciously made a small sound in wonder.
dialogues.text: I unconsciously made a small sound in wonder.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ですから、神社の成り立ちを考えると、一概
　に違うとも言い切れないんですが……」
dialogues.en:
"Although they are an important part of most shrines, and
although it's not explained in detail..."
dialogues.text:
"Although they are an important part of most shrines, and
although it's not explained in detail..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「巫女は霊媒師的役割の方が強かったんですね」
dialogues.en:
"In general, the abilties of Miko in channeling spirits is
stronger."
dialogues.text:
"In general, the abilties of Miko in channeling spirits is
stronger."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「れいばいし？」
dialogues.en: "Channeling spirits?"
dialogues.text: "Channeling spirits?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「はい。神の声を聞いたり、霊の声を聞いたり
　する役割をするのです」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. A Miko's duty is to listen to, and communicate the
words of the Gods and spirits."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. A Miko's duty is to listen to, and communicate the
words of the Gods and spirits."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「昔は巫女の言葉が、政治を左右したとも言わ
　れています」
dialogues.en:
"In olden days, the words of a Miko had a large influence in
the politics of the land."
dialogues.text:
"In olden days, the words of a Miko had a large influence in
the politics of the land."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「まあでも、今はそんなこともなくて、ほとん
　ど宮司や神主の補佐になってますけど」
dialogues.en:
"Of course, nowadays, no such thing takes place, and a
Miko's duty now is to assist the chief Shinto priest in
their duties."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, nowadays, no such thing takes place, and a
Miko's duty now is to assist the chief Shinto priest in
their duties."

dialogues.jp: なるほど。巫女にそんな歴史があったとは……。
dialogues.en: I see. Miko have a interesting history...
dialogues.text: I see. Miko have a interesting history...

dialogues.jp:
一部の人間に“萌え〜”と言われるための存在
じゃないんだな。
dialogues.en:
They don't just exist for fanboys to go "moeeee~" over,
apparently.
dialogues.text:
They don't just exist for fanboys to go "moeeee~" over,
apparently.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクも巫女さんになってみたい！」
dialogues.en: "I want to be a Miko too!"
dialogues.text: "I want to be a Miko too!"

dialogues.jp: さくらが瞳を輝かせてそう言い出した。
dialogues.en: Her eyes were sparkling at the mere thought of it.
dialogues.text: Her eyes were sparkling at the mere thought of it.

dialogues.jp:
「……今の説明聞いてなかったのか？　お前に
　は無理だ」
dialogues.en:
"...Didn't you just hear her explanation? You won't be able
to do it."
dialogues.text:
"...Didn't you just hear her explanation? You won't be able
to do it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それ、どういう意味かな？　お兄ちゃん！？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that, onii-chan!?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that, onii-chan!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「言葉通りだぞ」
dialogues.en: "Exactly what I said."
dialogues.text: "Exactly what I said."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Uuu~"
dialogues.text: "Uuu~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ……じゃあ、せめて、ボクも巫女服着て
　みたい！」
dialogues.en: "Then... then, I want to try on a Miko dress!"
dialogues.text: "Then... then, I want to try on a Miko dress!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、環ちゃん、ダメ？」
dialogues.en: "Will it be okay, Tamaki-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Will it be okay, Tamaki-chan?"

dialogues.jp: 環の腰に抱きついて、さくらが懇願する。
dialogues.en: She begged to Tamaki, hugging her hips.
dialogues.text: She begged to Tamaki, hugging her hips.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「確か、余ってた袴があると思いますので……
　いいですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I do believe we have a spare hakama somewhere... it should
be fine."
dialogues.text:
"I do believe we have a spare hakama somewhere... it should
be fine."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ほんと！？」
dialogues.en: "Really!?"
dialogues.text: "Really!?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: さくらは上機嫌で環に付いていく。
dialogues.en: Overjoyed, she followed Tamaki with a spring in her step.
dialogues.text: Overjoyed, she followed Tamaki with a spring in her step.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ」
dialogues.en: "Oy vey."
dialogues.text: "Oy vey."

dialogues.jp:
まるで、民族衣装を着るアトラクションみたい
だな。
dialogues.en: Seems like she's just attracted to the "national costume".
dialogues.text: Seems like she's just attracted to the "national costume".

dialogues.jp:
俺がお茶をすすっていると、ドタドタという神
社には相応しくない足音が響いてきた。
dialogues.en:
As I sipped my tea, my ears picked up the sound of
unnaturally hurried footsteps, getting louder and louder.
dialogues.text:
As I sipped my tea, my ears picked up the sound of
unnaturally hurried footsteps, getting louder and louder.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃ〜〜〜ん！！」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chaaaaaaaaa~~~n!"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chaaaaaaaaa~~~n!"

dialogues.jp:
巫女服を着たさくらが廊下を走って戻ってきた
ところだった。
dialogues.en:
The Miko dress-clad Sakura came bursting through the door
back to the room.
dialogues.text:
The Miko dress-clad Sakura came bursting through the door
back to the room.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねえねえ、どうかなどうかな？」
dialogues.en: "How does it look, how does it look?"
dialogues.text: "How does it look, how does it look?"

dialogues.jp: クルッと一回転してみせる。
dialogues.en: She twirled around once, to give me a good look.
dialogues.text: She twirled around once, to give me a good look.

dialogues.jp: 「意外だな」
dialogues.en: "Surprising."
dialogues.text: "Surprising."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「良く似合ってるじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "It actually looks good on you."
dialogues.text: "It actually looks good on you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへへ」
dialogues.en: "Eheheheh~"
dialogues.text: "Eheheheh~"

dialogues.jp: とろけるような笑顔を、さくらが浮かべる。
dialogues.en: She smiled, still enchanted with her dress.
dialogues.text: She smiled, still enchanted with her dress.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「子供用のサイズじゃ、少し小さいかと思った
　のですが」
dialogues.en: "I had thought that child size might be a bit too small."
dialogues.text: "I had thought that child size might be a bit too small."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ぴったりなのがあって、よかったです」
dialogues.en: "But thankfully, it fits perfectly."
dialogues.text: "But thankfully, it fits perfectly."

dialogues.jp:
遅れてやってきた環が、案外きついことをはっ
きり言った。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki followed in shortly after, with unexpectedly
insulting words.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki followed in shortly after, with unexpectedly
insulting words.

dialogues.jp:
さくらを見つめる眼差しは優しいから……まぁ、
悪気はないと思うんだけど。
dialogues.en:
But the way she looks at Sakura so lovingly... nah, there
couldn't have been any abd intentions.
dialogues.text:
But the way she looks at Sakura so lovingly... nah, there
couldn't have been any abd intentions.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねえねえ、写真撮ろうよ！」
dialogues.en: "I know! Let's take pictures!"
dialogues.text: "I know! Let's take pictures!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「カメラなら……これを使ってください」
dialogues.en: "That would require a camera... please use this."
dialogues.text: "That would require a camera... please use this."

dialogues.jp:
環にお土産用のインスタントカメラを手渡され
る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki passed me a souvenir-type instant camera.
dialogues.text: Tamaki passed me a souvenir-type instant camera.

dialogues.jp: 「ふーむ」
dialogues.en: "Mmmhmm."
dialogues.text: "Mmmhmm."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、早く早くっ！」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan, hurry!"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan, hurry!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらが環の腕をとって、思いっきり笑顔を浮
かべる。
dialogues.en: Sakura held onto Tamaki's arm, a wide smile on her face.
dialogues.text: Sakura held onto Tamaki's arm, a wide smile on her face.

dialogues.jp:
環もそれにつられたように、いつもより｛まぶ／眩｝しい
笑顔を浮かべた。
dialogues.en: Tamaki had her usual calm smile on hers, as well.
dialogues.text: Tamaki had her usual calm smile on hers, as well.

dialogues.jp: 俺はフレームの中のふたりを見つめて。
dialogues.en: I made sure both of them fit into the frame.
dialogues.text: I made sure both of them fit into the frame.

dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃあ、撮るぞ？」
dialogues.en: "Alright, say cheese!"
dialogues.text: "Alright, say cheese!"

dialogues.jp: シャッターを切った。
dialogues.en: With the press of a button, the shutter closed.
dialogues.text: With the press of a button, the shutter closed.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「次は、お兄ちゃんとボクで撮ろうね」
dialogues.en: "Next is onii-chan and me."
dialogues.text: "Next is onii-chan and me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, yeah."

dialogues.jp: さくらと俺が隣に並ぶ。
dialogues.en: Sakura lined herself up next to me.
dialogues.text: Sakura lined herself up next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、肩に手を回して」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan, put your arm around my shoulder!"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan, put your arm around my shoulder!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「なんでそんなかったるいことしなくちゃなら
　ないんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Why do I have to do such a troublesome thing?"
dialogues.text: "Why do I have to do such a troublesome thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクがして欲しいからだよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Because I want you to~"
dialogues.text: "Because I want you to~"

dialogues.jp:
そう言うと、さくらは有無を言わさず、俺の手
を引き、自分の肩の後ろへと回す。
dialogues.en:
Upon finishing her sentence, she immediately grabbed my arm,
and draped it around her shoulders, without waiting for my
reply.
dialogues.text:
Upon finishing her sentence, she immediately grabbed my arm,
and draped it around her shoulders, without waiting for my
reply.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「環ちゃん、今っ！」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki-chan, now!"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki-chan, now!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: さくらの声を合図に、環がシャッターを切った。
dialogues.en:
At the signal of Sakura's voice, the shutters closed once
again.
dialogues.text:
At the signal of Sakura's voice, the shutters closed once
again.

dialogues.jp: 「……ったく」

俺が文句のひとつでも言ってやろうとしている
と。
dialogues.en:
Even if I wanted to voice a complaint, I wouldn't be able to
get a word in.
dialogues.text:
Even if I wanted to voice a complaint, I wouldn't be able to
get a word in.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、次はお兄ちゃんと環ちゃんね」
dialogues.en: "Finally, onii-chan and Tamaki-chan!"
dialogues.text: "Finally, onii-chan and Tamaki-chan!"

dialogues.jp:
環からカメラを受け取って、さくらが俺と環を
ふたり並べた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura took the camera from Tamaki's hands, and guided her
beside me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura took the camera from Tamaki's hands, and guided her
beside me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしは……」
環がわずかに頬を赤く染めて、離れようとする。
dialogues.en:
A slight flush of red crept into her cheeks, as she tried to
step out.
dialogues.text:
A slight flush of red crept into her cheeks, as she tried to
step out.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えー、なんで？　まだフィルム余ってるんだ
　から、撮ろうよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh~, why not? There's still film! Let's take a picture~"
dialogues.text: "Ehhh~, why not? There's still film! Let's take a picture~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん、撮るまでさくらはうるさいぞ」
dialogues.en: "And if we don't, Sakura won't ever shut up anyway."
dialogues.text: "And if we don't, Sakura won't ever shut up anyway."

dialogues.jp: 俺がそう言うと。
dialogues.en: I encouraged her in my own way.
dialogues.text: I encouraged her in my own way.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉様がそうおっしゃられるのなら」
dialogues.en: "...If you say it that way..."
dialogues.text: "...If you say it that way..."

dialogues.jp: ためらいがちに環が俺の横に並ぶ。
dialogues.en: She hesitatingly placed herself beside me.
dialogues.text: She hesitatingly placed herself beside me.

dialogues.jp:
「さあ、さくら。早いとこ撮って終わりにしよ
　うぜ」
dialogues.en:
"Now, Sakura, hurry up and take the picture, then we're
done."
dialogues.text:
"Now, Sakura, hurry up and take the picture, then we're
done."

dialogues.jp: 俺がそう言った時だった。
dialogues.en: But as I said that,
dialogues.text: But as I said that,

dialogues.jp: かすかに耳に届くほどの小さい声。
dialogues.en: I heard a barely audible voice.
dialogues.text: I heard a barely audible voice.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わ、私の肩も、さくらさんのように……組ん
　でくれませんか」
dialogues.en:
"C, could you... do that with my shoulders, like you did to
Sakura-san?"
dialogues.text:
"C, could you... do that with my shoulders, like you did to
Sakura-san?"

dialogues.jp:
頬を赤くするとかそう言うレベルを通り越して、
明らかに顔を真っ赤にして、環が俺を見つめて
くる。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes were fully concentrated at me now, the slight flush
from before levelling up to a full-blown blush.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes were fully concentrated at me now, the slight flush
from before levelling up to a full-blown blush.

dialogues.jp: 環がそんなこと言うなんて……。
dialogues.en: For Tamaki to say something like that...
dialogues.text: For Tamaki to say something like that...

dialogues.jp: 「別にいいけど……」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine with it..."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine with it..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は驚きながらも、環の肩を抱いた。
dialogues.en:
Still slightly shocked, I reached my arm around her
shoulders.
dialogues.text:
Still slightly shocked, I reached my arm around her
shoulders.

dialogues.jp: 俺の手の平を通して、環の体温が感じられる。
dialogues.en:
Through the palm of my hand, I could feel her body
temperature flowing through me.
dialogues.text:
Through the palm of my hand, I could feel her body
temperature flowing through me.

dialogues.jp: 環って、意外に｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝なんだな。
dialogues.en: She really feels so slender and delicate...
dialogues.text: She really feels so slender and delicate...

dialogues.jp: 肩幅も小さいし……。
dialogues.en: And her shoulders seem so tiny...
dialogues.text: And her shoulders seem so tiny...

dialogues.jp: あれ？
dialogues.en: Eh?
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.jp: 俺、なんでドキドキしてるんだ？
dialogues.en: Why'm I thinking such things?
dialogues.text: Why'm I thinking such things?

dialogues.jp: 環に心臓の音が聞こえないかビクビクする。
dialogues.en:
My heart was beating so fast, I was afraid Tamaki would hear
it...
dialogues.text:
My heart was beating so fast, I was afraid Tamaki would hear
it...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、いくよ〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Here we go~"
dialogues.text: "Here we go~"

dialogues.jp: シャッターの音と共に。
dialogues.en: With the sound of the shutters closing,
dialogues.text: With the sound of the shutters closing,

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は並んでフレームに収まった。
dialogues.en: Came the capturing of the two of us on the frame of a photo.
dialogues.text: Came the capturing of the two of us on the frame of a photo.

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、俺の顔は、環に負けないくらい真っ赤
になっているって、現像するまでもなくそう思っ
た。
dialogues.en:
When it develops, I'd probably have a blush rivaling that of
Tamaki's...
dialogues.text:
When it develops, I'd probably have a blush rivaling that of
Tamaki's...

dialogues.jp: ◆巫女装束のさくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura In A Miko Costume?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura In A Miko Costume?◆

dialogues.jp:
俺は、巫女に興味のあるさくらを連れて神社へ
行った。
dialogues.en: I accompanied the Miko-obssessed Sakura to the shrine.
dialogues.text: I accompanied the Miko-obssessed Sakura to the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは環に間違った巫女観を披露し、苦笑さ
れるが、環は巫女について詳しく説明してくれ
る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's perceptions of a Miko were completely off. Tamaki
corrected and explained further with good-naturedness.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's perceptions of a Miko were completely off. Tamaki
corrected and explained further with good-naturedness.

dialogues.jp:
巫女について更に興味を持ったさくらは、巫女
装束が着たいと環に頼む。
dialogues.en:
With her interest in Miko only piqued further, Sakura begged
Tamaki to try on a Miko dress.
dialogues.text:
With her interest in Miko only piqued further, Sakura begged
Tamaki to try on a Miko dress.

dialogues.jp:
環、さくらと巫女二人と写真撮影をするはめに
なるのだった。
dialogues.en:
And I ended up taking photographs with the two Miko
dress-clad girls.
dialogues.text:
And I ended up taking photographs with the two Miko
dress-clad girls.

dialogues.jp: なかなか悪くない。
dialogues.en: Not a bad thing to do.
dialogues.text: Not a bad thing to do.
